other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered building/construction worker under the Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Beneficiary must be the nominee of a deceased registered construction worker
Application for the benefit must be submitted within one year of the worker’s death
benefits_summary: Provides a ₹4,000 funeral assistance and a ₹71,000 ex‑gratia payment to the nominee of a deceased registered construction worker.
